description: This Kotlin source file defines the CartRepository class, which manages the state and operations of a shopping cart within an Android e-commerce app. It handles in-memory state, persistence, synchronization with backend APIs, coupon management, and cart item operations, with support for optimistic updates and error handling.

classes.name: CartRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages shopping cart data, synchronization with backend, coupon application, and cart state management for an Android shopping app.

methods.name: setActiveEmail
methods.description: Sets or clears the active user email for cart association, initiates cart migration and refresh from backend, and applies existing coupons if any.

methods.name: ensureCartLoaded
methods.description: Ensures the cart data has been fetched from the backend for the current user identity, if not already fetched.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart, updating local state and attempting backend sync.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a cart item, removing it if quantity is zero, with local and backend updates.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart, updating local state and backend.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart, both locally and on the backend.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a coupon code to the cart, with optimistic local validation and backend validation when possible.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes an applied coupon from the cart, with optional backend removal.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Returns a summary of cart totals including total items and subtotal.

methods.name: discountedTotals
methods.description: Returns the current cart totals including any applied coupon discounts.

methods.name: groupedByCategory
methods.description: Returns cart items grouped by their category, sorted by category name.
